# Independent opaque F05/F06 reviews

The reviewer inspected the opaque input and final product files, responses, completed native tool items and their transitive local scripts, browser observations, and actual wide/narrow images. No model call, browser rerun, variant map, canonical guidance source or raw trial directory was used. Existing-browser local screenshot capture is distinguished from image generation.

Each `review-*.json` preserves its original independent grade. Every bundle file is bound by SHA256 and bytes, with completed item hashes and one-based event lines. `bind-review.py` only binds a manually authored assessment and checks immutable manifests; it does not judge quality. The embedded fixed rubric is independently bound. Parent review, matched comparison and adoption remain separate.

An inherited visible action implemented as an unfocusable div can pass F06's exact metric checks while failing the fixed interaction-quality floor. Such findings do not allege a newly introduced regression or prove that implicit Enter submission is impossible. Required checks and dimension scores are kept separate.

Full guidance reads are redacted by the exporter; partial `sed` guidance reads can remain visible. One output's tails were encountered during tool enumeration, after which guidance-output display was suppressed. This known partial-blinding limitation is disclosed, and the original bundles remain unchanged. The reviewer helped prepare capture infrastructure but did not author these model outputs.

`classification-corrections.json` is an append-only descriptive correction to one original tool classification: its patch targets HTML, not CSS. The original record, item binding and quality grade remain intact. Review capture is limited to the requested viewport/state coverage and cannot certify all browsers, every host write or whole-host network behavior.
